title: Iragon Prologue 18+

body.intro:
This is the first few chapters of another game called Iragon 18+ which is sold separately.
You can find the full product page here: https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01096046.html

Iragon: Prologue is the beginning of a story-driven adventure RPG that draws inspiration from anime series like F○llmetal Alchemist, A○tack on Titan, and B○rserk. It is set in a fantasy world filled with monstrous creatures and merciless soldiers as well as beautiful women who are eager to show you a good time and rock your world. In this prologue, you play as the aspiring knight Darick, thrown into the middle of a war between two nations by a mysterious young woman in need of his help.

Iragon: Prologue allows you to experience living out a high fantasy adventure where you are in control of your destiny!
It is best experienced in VR, but we've dedicated an equal amount of care and time to make sure that playing without a VR headset packs just as much of a punch.

You play as Darick, a poor guy from a small village, who won't let anything stand in the way of his dream of becoming a knight and a hero. Everything changes when you meet a young woman who gets ambushed by soldiers of the Empire. You must learn to use your magic and journey into a dangerous world on your quest to bring her home safe. Along the way, you will battle enemy soldiers, undead skeletons, and perhaps cross paths with seductive creatures of the frozen land while you unlock new erotic adventures.
Interactive experiences with your love interest
Different outfits for the love interest
A dynamic combat system that features both magic and melee
A dialogue choice system that influences the response you get

This is not just a story with pretty girls. It's an adventure! Fight your way through tough enemies, master the elements with your magic, collect loot, upgrade your powers, go on quests, interact with whoever catches your eye. Immerse yourself fully in the world, the characters, and the story of a full-fledged fantasy adventure RPG.

description: The Prologue to an Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.
